{{Quote|It's a dark Jedi! This fight is too much for us&mdash;we better stay back. All we'd do is get in the way.|Trask Ulgo, upon seeing the Dark Jedi|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Dark Jedi''' was part of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Darth Malak]], the newly proclaimed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], in [[3956 BBY]]. During that [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] was part of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Darth Bandon]], Malak's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], that [[Attack on the Endar Spire|ambushed]] and boarded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' in search of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]], under orders from Malak to capture her alive for her proficiency with [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. During the battle, the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] a [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Endar Spire)|Jedi Master]] in a hallway connected to the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], where he was [[Death/Legends|struck down]].

==Biography==
[[File:Endar_Spire_Duel.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Dark Jedi duels a Jedi aboard the ''Endar Spire''.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and became a member of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] of [[Darth Malak]], the former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] and self-proclaimed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KotOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="CG" /> the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was part of a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by [[Darth Bandon]],<ref name="KotOR" /> Malak's Sith apprentice and [[Shadow Hand]],<ref name="CG" /> that [[Attack on the Endar Spire|ambushed]] and boarded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in an effort to capture [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]], whose skill with [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] Malak coveted.<ref name="KotOR" />

During the ambush, the Dark Jedi encountered a [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Endar Spire)|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> in the hallways leading to the ''Endar Spire''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|engaged]] her in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]. The amnesiac Revan and [[Trask Ulgo]], two [[Republic soldier]]s, witnessed the remainder of the duel, which concluded with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Dark Jedi. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was also killed shortly afterward when the wall section behind her was destroyed from heavy damage from the Sith fleet.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Personality and traits==
A Human male, the Dark Jedi had fair skin and [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He kept his [[Hair/Legends|hair]] shaved to the skull.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Powers and abilities==
As a member of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Malak's Sith Empire, the Dark Jedi wielded a red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and outfitted himself with a set of [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|Sith armor]]. Despite his skill with a lightsaber, however, the Dark Jedi was unable to prevent his death at the hands of the Jedi Master.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Jedi's first appearance was as a non-player character in a cutscene of the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]. He was later briefly mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Knights of the Old Republic'' strategy guide]].
